item.title: Week 10: Patriots at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 9:30 AM ET | Line: DET -2.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model DET 54% vs. market 57% | On paper this is close: Detroit's pass rush ranks 3rd in pressure rate (23%) against New England's 24th-ranked 23%, while New England counters with the 7th-best EPA per dropback (+0.18) against Detroit's 20th-ranked defense (+0.05 allowed). Drake Maye (9th of 31) and Jared Goff (11th) are close in EPA per dropback, and Amon-Ra St. Brown, who takes 33% of Detroit's targets and 36% of its air yards, meets a New England pass defense ranked 21st. The model favors Detroit at 54%, led by rushing matchup (1.2 points) and offensive injuries (0.3 points), both toward Detroit.
